QuestInfo.name: Mu Lung's Contribution
QuestInfo.0: Mu Lung, the village of pandas... What a mystical place. Ask Tae Sang about anyone suspicious he may have seen.
QuestInfo.1: Tae Sang saw some shady characters around Mu Lung, but he didn't pay much attention to them. He suggests you speak with Tae Soo at the Peach Farm, since he stays there and might know more about where they went.
QuestInfo.2: You found Tae Soo, the peach farm manager.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,536,020\nCan proceed to the Tae Soo and You quest

0.0: A suspicious group of people wearing odd clothing passed through when I was on my way to the Peach Farm. They sort of looked like you, actually. That whole frilly, antique style you've got going.
0.1: I didn't pay much attention. I was inspecting the trees. The blossoms are particularly vibrant this time of year. Talk to Tae Soo. He's the farmer around here.

yes.0: Exit Mu Lung and head west to get to the Peach Farm. Tae Soo looks after the farm, so he should be easy to find. And be sure to marvel at the trees!

no.0: I see. Well, it looks like you're on your own.

1.0: What a healthy tree! This year's harvest should be excellent. ...Oh, hello there. Were you looking for me?

default.0: Head west from Mu Lung to reach the Peach Farm. Tae Soo should be there.
